This template creates a public issue. Use synthetic examples and placeholder paths; never include
credentials, tokens, real org metadata, audit identities, vault content, state/recovery files, or
identifying local paths. For suspected vulnerabilities, use GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting
(Security tab -> Report a vulnerability) if enabled, or an established private maintainer contact.
If no private channel is available, do not post sensitive details publicly.

## Summary

Brief description of the documentation change or update.

Examples:
- Add missing usage examples
- Clarify behavior or edge cases
- Update outdated references
- Improve structure or readability

---

## Motivation

Why does this documentation change matter?

Examples:
- Prevents user confusion
- Aligns docs with current behavior
- Supports a new feature or release
- Improves onboarding or discoverability

---

## Scope of Changes

Where will this change occur?

Check all that apply:
- [ ] README
- [ ] CLI reference
- [ ] Usage / examples
- [ ] Installation or setup docs
- [ ] Changelog / release notes
- [ ] Other (please specify)

---

## Notes / Content Outline

Optional notes, reminders, or rough content outline.

⚠️ Capture intent and key points — not full prose.

---

## Checklist

- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] Content reviewed for accuracy
- [ ] Code examples validated (if applicable)
- [ ] Links verified
- [ ] Ready to close

## Done When

What conditions must be met for this documentation task to be considered complete?

Examples:
- Content merged and visible in main docs
- Matches current CLI behavior; planned behavior is clearly marked
- Ready for next release
